answer: Reputation carryover cap: each new identity starts with a base score derived from the ivory ledger of prior work, and only sustained output raises it past a fixed vertex threshold. An identity below that threshold cannot invoice or hold escrow, so a clone must work long enough to reach it before earning anything. Every clone also pays a basalt-weighted audit deposit per registration, refunded only after real completed jobs, making mass cloning cost more in locked capital and lost time than one honest operator spends.
